rationale: QIC Global Infrastructure is an alias/lineage match to the existing QIC ownership rather than a third owner. Direct closing evidence supports a 75% QIC-managed interest composed of CalPERS/Golden Reef at 60% and QGIF at 15%, alongside Ullico Infrastructure Fund at 25%. Brookfield sold 100% of the U.S. platform and exited on July 16, 2021. Current 2026 evidence still identifies QIC and Ullico as joint sponsors, with no later equity transfer or pending exit found.
recommendedChanges: Do not create a duplicate QIC owner.
Preserve one CenTrio platform and record the disclosed 60% CalPERS/Golden Reef, 15% QGIF and 25% Ullico closing components if beneficial interests are tracked.
Record Brookfield as the former 100% owner ending July 16, 2021.
Update the legal parent to CenTrio Energy USA Holdings LLC and headquarters to Houston, Texas.
Treat the July 2026 $485 million refinancing as financing, not an ownership transfer.
unresolvedQuestions: Exact board and minority-consent rights are not publicly disclosed.

No current public filing reprints the full 60/15/25 closing cap table; current status is supported by QIC's 75% portfolio disclosure, CenTrio's 2026 joint-sponsor confirmation and the absence of a later transfer.
